claims.statement: DataQuery validates pagination, sort, filter, and projection inputs, applies allowlists when configured, uses a default page limit of 100, and never permits more than 500 rows.

normalize_rows supports mappings, sequences of mappings or Hedron models, and optional dataframe inputs through Narwhals, while refusing implicit lazy collection and rejecting inline datasets over 10,000 rows.
DataPage, ColumnSchema, CellUpdate, DataChanges, DataSaveResult, and the DataEditorSource protocols define the shared fetch/apply and conflict-reporting contract for editable tabular data.
DataTable renders an accessible server-side table, preserves total/version metadata, masks secret values, and excludes hidden or secret columns from CSV output.
DataEditor keeps save policy on the server: filter_writable_changes rejects unauthorized field writes, filters insert fields, and applies the configured delete policy.
TransformPlan limits execution to allowlisted operations and enforces row and serialized-byte budgets, while carrying optional tenant, cancellation, and authorization context.

OptimisticMutation requires typed patches and idempotency, tracks explicit lifecycle states, and restricts the phase-0.62 inventory to collection edits, reversible toggles, and scalar edits while higher-risk classes are denied by default.
The repository tests data contracts and transform budgets and verifies that DataEditor JSON saves require the CSRF token header before applying an authorized update.
